_metadata._purpose: Cloneable tenant-config skeleton for any new Chronova prospect. To use: copy this directory to data/<prospect-slug>/, edit values, then run migrate_tenant_data.py --tenant-config <path>. See README.md in this folder for the full onboarding flow.

Q1_tenancy_model.source: decisions/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS-QA.md (Q1, Option A recommended, Venkat to confirm in working session)
Q1_tenancy_model.notes: Shared MariaDB with logical row-level partitioning by the `company` field. ~$60/mo at 20 tenants. HRMS treats `company` as a first-class field on Employee/Department/Shift Type/Leave Allocation/Attendance. Migrate to per-tenant DB only at ~30 tenants or on a physical-isolation demand.

Q2_app_name.notes: Python module name, Git remote, role-profile prefix all use `chronova`. Replacing the legacy `college-hr-foundation` and misspelled `haritha_hospital`. Locked; do not change per-prospect.

Q3_saas_domain.source: decisions/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS-QA.md (Q3, recommended, Venkat to buy in working session)
Q3_saas_domain.notes: India-first TLD, cheapest, .in namespace less saturated. Fallback TLDs if .in is taken: chronova.com (~₹900-1500/yr) > chronova.app > chronova.co > chronova.io. Update this field AND any SSL/HTTPS config when changing the TLD.

Q4_pilot_company.notes: Set to the legal name of the first/pilot college once Venkat names it in the working session. This value travels through to all pilot-era communications (welcome email, SOW, case-study copy). For the second-and-later prospects, set to the prospect's own name (not literally a 'pilot') and update the notes.

_placeholders._comment: Strict JSON does not allow // inline comments. The fields below are empty strings or null by design — they MUST be filled by the consultant before running migrate_tenant_data.py. Search for the placeholder names to find them in this file.
_placeholders.company_name: Required. Full legal name of the prospect's institution (must match `name` column in company.csv). Example: 'St. Mary's Engineering College'.
_placeholders.company_abbr: Required. ≤5 chars, used in autoname series (e.g. HR-SHA-2026-11-00001). Example: 'SMEC'. Must also match `abbr` column in company.csv.
_placeholders.default_shift_location: Optional. Human-readable campus label used if no shift_location.csv is provided. Example: 'Main Campus - Hyderabad'. Set to null if every shift is location-agnostic.
_placeholders.holidays_fiscal_year_label: Cosmetic. Display string for the holiday list (e.g. 'FY 2027-28'). Leave as '' to auto-derive from fiscal_year_start_month.
_placeholders.fiscal_year_start_month: If the prospect is NOT in India, change to 1 (Jan-start, US/EU) or 7 (Jul-start, AU). 4 = April (India FY).
_placeholders.timezone: If the prospect is NOT in India, set the IANA tz (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London').
_placeholders.approver_user: Pre-seeded as the Department Approver for Shift Requests. Default 'Administrator' is fine for the first dry-run; replace with the prospect's HR head's Frappe user ID before live migration.
